desc: At only eight ounces, the MOE Trigger Release (TR) is one of Magpul’s lightest stocks. Thanks to its ambidextrous, textured Trigger Release adjustment mechanism, it’s also one of the easiest for making LOP adjustments, as well as installing or removing the stock. The Trigger Release combines with a newly developed takedown lever that also makes the MOE TR stock our easiest stock to install and remove on your firearm. That means no more leveraging a high-tension spring to mount and remove your stock; the innovative, one-handed toolless takedown lever allows quick and easy installation and removal. It includes a “padlock” icon to indicate whether the stock is locked or unlocked. Once the lever is positioned in the “locked” position, it can’t be removed from the receiver extension, ensuring it won’t slide off when making LOP adjustments. The takedown lever is also partially recessed to minimize snagging while still permitting easy access to select it when necessary. For sling attachment, the TR includes ambidextrous M-LOK slots on each side of rear of the stock that function as a footman’s loop or a space to attach M-LOK QD Sling Mounts.
